title: Cities of Refuge for the Manslayer
description: Moses establishes rules for setting up three cities of refuge in the land Israel is to occupy, so that someone who has killed their neighbor unintentionally—such as by an accident while chopping wood—can flee there and save their life from the avenger of blood. The roads must be made passable, and the land divided into three parts; when the Lord expands the territory, three more cities shall be added. But if someone hates their neighbor and kills them with intent, the elders shall hand them over to the avenger of blood, so that innocent blood is not shed among the people.
